issues.message: OrderDate and stockTag are exported but never used. Fix: Remove the unused OrderDate and stockTag exports or use them where stock and dates are shown.

issues.message: isSoldOut is exported but never used. Fix: Remove the unused isSoldOut export or use it where sold-out is decided.

issues.message: changePassword writes the plaintext password to persistent browser storage. Fix: Do not persist the password in the persistent store or any browser storage and never show it back; keep only the session and handle the password change without storing the secret.

issues.message: Records are read through async functions instead of through the operation hooks. Fix: Read records only through the entity layer hooks such as useLookupOrder and useListOrders instead of calling the lookupOrder and listOrders functions directly.

issues.message: S03 step 1 requires photos, title, description, price and category but the page never shows the category. Fix: Show the piece category (FD05) by its label beside the title, description and price.
issues.at: web/app/(routes)/(marketing)/shop/[pieceId]/page.tsx

issues.message: S01 hero media builds piece preview by hand with Card without photo, category or link instead of a CardList of piece cards. Fix: Render the hero media preview from PieceCards/CardList with photo, title link, price, category and stock/sold-out for up to 3 in-stock pieces.
issues.at: web/app/(routes)/(marketing)/page.tsx

issues.message: Glaze-and-size variants show the raw size key small/medium/large instead of its Small/Medium/Large label. Fix: Map every displayed size key through SizeOptions labels so it reads Small, Medium or Large in S03, S04, S06, S10, S11 and S13.
issues.at: web/app/(routes)/(marketing)/shop/[pieceId]/page.tsx

issues.message: S20 password edit adds a second labeled field with help text and a Done button under the record instead of an in-place edit. Fix: Edit the password in place with no label and no help text and icon edit/save/cancel buttons beside the value, or in a dialog.
issues.at: web/app/(routes)/(app)/dashboard/account/page.tsx

issues.message: No screen uses Truncate for one-line text such as titles, cells, breadcrumbs or status lines. Fix: Wrap every text meant for one line in Truncate so it cuts with ellipsis and tooltip instead of wrapping or overflowing.
issues.at: web/app/blocks/pieces/PieceCards.tsx

issues.message: changePassword writes the plaintext password into persistent browser storage. Fix: Do not persist the password: remove `passwords` from the persistent store and keep nothing secret in browser storage, logs, URLs, or UI.
issues.at: web/app/entities/auth/index.ts

issues.message: Checkout decrements each piece's stock then creates the order with no atomicity, leaving partial stock loss when a later step fails. Fix: Make stock decrements and order creation atomic in one entity operation with rollback, or restore any decremented stock and tell the user exactly what was and was not saved.
issues.at: web/app/(routes)/(marketing)/checkout/page.tsx

issues.message: Cancel restores stock piece-by-piece then cancels with no guard or atomicity, so failure or a second press can double-restore stock while reporting unchanged. Fix: Make stock restore plus cancellation a single atomic operation with a running guard so a second press does nothing, and report exactly what failed without claiming the order is unchanged after partial restores.
issues.at: web/app/(routes)/(app)/dashboard/orders/[orderId]/page.tsx

issues.message: Percentage discounts stay fractional so separately rounded shown discount and total can differ by ₹1. Fix: Round the discount to whole rupees once (e.g. Math.round) before computing shipping and total so the shown total equals shown subtotal minus shown discount plus shown shipping.
issues.at: web/app/blocks/orders/money.ts

issues.message: Mark paid, advance, cancel, deactivate and remove run without a running guard so a second press re-runs the operation. Fix: Disable each mutating button while its operation runs so a second press while it runs does nothing, as done for form submits.

issues.message: Cancelling restores stock by matching piece title and silently skips missing or renamed pieces, leaving stock inconsistent.
